scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-size existence and small-size identifiability. Exact finite rational enumeration used as a check, not an infinite proof. No independent external scientific audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli-edge path transmission, unknown common p in (0,1), exact population mean and variance only. Ambiguity for n>=5 does not imply equality of full size distributions or extend to correlated-duration SIR. Unlocated equivalent results remain possible.
title: Five vertices are sharp for two-moment epidemic-source ambiguity on paths
